text.p: (Figures in millions of French francs unless stated)

NOTE - Eridania gave the figures in a statement. It said its 1996 accounts consolidated the activities of Cerestar USA over twelve months, those of Compagnie Francaise de Sucrerie over nine months as well as five other companies it acquired in the animal feed sector.
On a comparable structure and exchange rates, turnover would have risen by 0.7 percent.
Operating profit fell by 6.2 percent despite the contribution of Compagnie Francaise de Sucrerie.
Eridania said the second half of the year was more favourable than the first but that some businesses were hurt by bad farm campaigns and the increase in raw material prices that followed.

Net profit rose by 8.8 percent on the back of lower financial costs, stable taxes and a reduction in extraoardinary charges. Gearing ratio stood at 0.70 at the end of December 1996 against 0.68 a year ago.
